text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's going on all of a sudden?
Calling me out here with such a pale face.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Please, calm down and...
listen to what I have to say...
CB-san, today, you are—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...This is the absolute, most catastrophically unlucky day of my life...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ooh, great great great curse, huh.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: So, I shall grant you this special gift! C.B.-san, your lucky item of the day: 'orange-colored food or drink'—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Here's a grilled carrot I happened to buy earlier! Please take extra care today!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, really?
Isn't that your snack, Fukukitaru...?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine!
Nothing is more important than your safety, C.B.-san!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
? Oh, I see. Thank you.
Well then, I'll gladly accept.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, sorry, sorry. It's just that it looked so delicious—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It's my lucky item, you know!?
What kind of terrible misfortune is going to happen now!
W-W-We need to find a replacement right this instant—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm terribly sorry that it's half-finished,
but if it means warding off absolute doom—
